articles.title: The Biggest World Cup Ever Is Coming — and It’s Right in Our Backyard!
articles.summary: Imagine 48 teams, 104 games, and a trophy chase across three countries! The 2026 FIFA Men’s World Cup kicks off June 11 in Mexico City, with the final at MetLife Stadium in New Jersey. Will Argentina repeat, or will a new champ rise?

articles.title: Floetry Brings Butterflies and Big Smiles to the Tiny Desk
articles.summary: The R&B duo Floetry — Natalie Stewart and Marsha Ambrosius — stopped by NPR’s Tiny Desk during their first tour in ten years. They sang hits like “Butterflies” and joked about steamy songs being too early in the day. The audience sang along, and the joy was contagious!

articles.title: This Swimmer Just Keeps Getting Faster — and He’s Only a College Freshman!
articles.summary: Koby Bujak-Upton, a Tennessee swimmer, smashed his own best times in three races at the MAC Charlotte Open. He’s now the fastest freshman ever in the 200-yard freestyle. Next stop: the Australian Trials, where he’ll try to make the national team!
